council_map.notes: NOT a city-run layer: published by ArcGIS user cmoore92 (web map 'New Albany City Council Map', tags Floyd County). Extent lat ~38.3, lon ~-85.8 (New Albany IN). services5 layer: count {"count":6}; DISTRICT values '1'..'6' (also DISTRICTN numeric, ID). A sibling layer https://services.arcgis.com/EAoy39bcmpweKJ4f/arcgis/rest/services/New_Albany_2020_Census_Council_Districts/FeatureServer/0 (the one the web map uses) returns {"count":9}: DISTRICT '1'-'5','6' and three '6-2024' rows (a 2024 change to district 6). Saved raw/new-albany-in/layer1-*.json (services.arcgis.com) and layer2 attrs/count (services5). City's own sources: precinct map PDF https://cityofnewalbany.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/councildistrict-precinctmap.pdf (saved) and per-district PDFs https://cityofnewalbany.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/2023-Districts-1.pdf ..-6.pdf (not downloaded). Verify against the city PDF before use.

notes: Roster page undated, but terms shown 01/01/24-12/31/27 and Oct 2025 minutes list Collier, Phipps, FitzGerald, Gohmann, Blair, Griffith, Murphy, Unruh present with President Dickey presiding, consistent with page.
